svg.title: rrum
svg.desc: Hexagonal logo for the R package rrum. A solid staircase descends from left to right in four treads over a faint dot grid, at the reduced RUM's success probabilities: about .89 for an examinee who holds every skill the item needs, then .58, .36 and .21 as one, two and three skills go missing, each drop labelled with the penalty r star that causes it. The drops shrink, because each penalty takes a fraction of what is left. The four letters of the word rrum stand one to a tread, so the name walks down the stairs. Around each tread an orange band shows the middle two thirds of the posterior for that probability.
